name: lying whole body stretch
description: A gentle whole-body stretch performed lying face down with the arms reaching forward and the legs lengthening back.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight behind you.
Reach your fingertips forward and your toes backward to lengthen through the body.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe slowly; you do not need to lift your chest or legs high.
Hold briefly, then release the reach.
